parsed.rationale: A newly invited analyst cannot access the workspace and receives an 'access denied' message after accepting the invite, while other users can log in normally. This is an invite/permission/workspace access issue with limited information to suggest a security or outage incident.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the details. Sorry the new analyst is running into access issues after accepting the invite. Since other users can log in normally, this sounds most likely related to the specific workspace/role assigned to that invite.

To help us resolve this quickly today, could you please share:
1) The workspace name (or workspace ID) the invite was for.
2) The exact “access denied” message text (verbatim) and where it appears (after login, or when trying to open a specific workspace page/action).
3) The role/permissions you intended for the analyst (e.g., role name) or what role she was assigned in the invite.
4) Whether any other newly invited users have the same issue, or if it’s only this analyst.

Once we have those, we can verify the invite/workspace assignment and advise the next step to restore access.
promised_actions: Review the invite/workspace assignment details once the requested information is provided
Advise the next step to restore the analyst’s access
safety_notes: No claim of root cause, outage status, or security determination.
Kept response focused on verifying permissions/invite details based on the provided facts.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, blocking their ability to use the workspace while other users remain able to log in.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
The invited analyst accepts the invite.
After accepting the invite, the analyst receives an “access denied” message.
Other users can log in normally.
missing_information: Which workspace/account the analyst is trying to access (workspace name or identifier).
The exact wording of the “access denied” message (verbatim) and where it appears (login page vs. specific workspace action).
Whether the invited analyst was assigned a role/permissions intended for access (role name and what she was granted).
Whether the issue affects any other newly invited users or only this analyst.
Whether other users’ successful logins are to the same workspace as the new analyst.
risk_signals: Ambiguity around the cause because only one user is affected and the error message content/details are not provided.
Potential permission/invite configuration problem, but no evidence of broader outage or security incident is stated.
parsed.summary: A newly invited analyst accepts the invite but then receives an “access denied” message and cannot log into the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
